author: GitHub
description:
Get to your draft pull requests even faster by letting GitHub Copilot start the work directly from Jira. In this video, we walk through three simple ways to trigger Copilot: setting it as the assignee, mentioning it in a comment, or using Atlassian automation. Watch how Copilot asks clarifying questions, streams its activity log right in your Jira chat pane, and creates a ready-to-review PR in GitHub.
